'''Veil''' can refer to the following:

* [[Eldrene's Veil]] - a waterfall in the [[Two Rivers]].
* "Black-veiled Aiel" - an idiom meaning belligerent.
* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 46|Veils]]'' - the forty-sixth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Chapter 14|What a Veil Hides]]'' - the forteenth chapter of ''[[Winter's Heart]]''.

==See also==
* [[Aiel]] - a race of warriors who wear veils when fighting.
* [[Shara]] - a land on the other side of the [[Aiel Waste]], where visitors are required to wear veils.
* [[Tarabon]] - a nation where transparent veils are worn over the bottom half of the face, by both men and women.
